correctness.rationale: The complement contains zero and all integers>=120 while all positive nongaps>=60; hence the complement of G is additively closed and G is a genuine genus-63 gapset. Shifting H=G−1 yields exact interval sumsets for 2<=n<=8; independently enumerated them as sizes 186,311,434,558,683,807,930. At n=8 the missing 15 top deficit classes coincide exactly with gaps E of numerical semigroup <6,7>. Since 118−H is contained in <6,7>, these deficits can never occur. Inductively nH contains [0,118n−30], whose translates by [0,58] and 118 cover [0,118(n+1)−30]; every other top deficit d<=29 has representation d=6u+7v with u+v<=4 and arises from 112/111/118 digits. Thus for all n>=8, nH=[0,118n] minus exactly the 15 prohibited deficits, giving |nG|=118n−14 and beta(n)=48−6n. The infinite induction, not finite numerical checks, proves all n.
